item.title: Why 'What's Opera, Doc?' looks like that
OpenAI agent hacked Australian government website, PM says
item.description:
📝 Cachella SmithLive reporter Image source, EPAAs discussions took place at the UN General Assembly in New York about the opportunities AI provides - and how best to manage it - Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that the country's universal health insurance scheme had been hacked by an OpenAI agent. "It took the company way too long to inform the government," Albanese said, adding that the method of notifying officials was also "unacceptable". Our cyber correspondent, Joe Tidy, writes that experts believe the systems were poorly protected - but more important is that this is not the first instance of AI agents ignoring laws on accessing online information.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cvgl73pxgndwt
